description: This file implements RADIUS server functionality within a hostapd-based Wi-Fi access point, including TLS event handling, user data management, RADIUS attribute parsing, and server setup.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info, logging relevant messages.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_user_data structure, setting up kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius_user_data, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data into radius_user_data from a blob attribute, parsing 'users' and 'wildcard' entries.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads user data from a specified file, updating user phase data if the file has changed.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user data blob by username, matching against kvlist and wildcard patterns.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses a radius attribute blob into structured data, handling different formats.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts the number of attributes and total size needed for radius attributes based on user data.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a radius attribute to the current attribute buffer, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses radius attributes from blob data and adds them to the attribute buffer.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from blob data and updates the eap_user structure.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates user state for a given username, parsing user attributes and initializing eap_user.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Main callback to retrieve EAP user info based on identity, supporting phase1 and phase2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes the radius server and TLS context with configuration parameters.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_state structure, setting up user data.

methods.name: radius_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes radius_state, freeing resources and shutting down server.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the radius main program.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the radius server program, parsing command-line options, initializing, and running event loop.
